title: Oh No! No Seatbelt! 🚗 Buckle Up Song with Baby Ava | Car Safety for Kids | Crayon Babies
description:
Oh no! Baby Ava is in her pink car seat, but her seatbelt is open! 🚗 Sing along as Ava puts her arms in, clicks the buckle and feels snug and safe – then help her answer: in the car, what do we do?

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Oh no! No seatbelt!" – the straps are open
💪 Arms in, arms in! One, two!
🔴 Click, click! Buckle up! Clap, clap, click – clap with me!
🤗 Snug and safe! Pat, pat, pat!
🤔 "In the car, what do we do?" – can you say it? BUCKLE UP! Yay!
👋 Click, click! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: car safety for toddlers • buckle up in the car • car seat • click • snug and safe

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

A fun car safety song for toddlers and preschoolers: Baby Ava sits in her car seat for a family trip, puts her arms in the straps, clicks the buckle, pats her snug straps and asks you what we always do in the car. Before every car ride – and on holiday trips to Grandma's – buckle up with Ava! Grown-ups: always check that your little one's straps are snug and clicked.
